entities.name: Fall of Sumifa
entities.description: Event of the Brothers' War that ended old Sumifa under a sandstorm.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: A kingdom buried under sand by Porros.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: Crown prince of Sumifa and songmage who betrays his order and is cursed into a sand wraith.

entities.name: Samor
entities.description: Leader of the songmages of Sumifa and Porros's mentor.

entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: Mountain beneath which the cockatrice was bound.

entities.name: Nessian Caves
entities.description: Shelter to which the people fled.

events.summary: Porros flies to Samor's office, having betrayed his order to claim leadership by force.
events.quote: prompted him to betray his order and claim the leadership by force

events.summary: Porros's discordant tone makes Samor bind the cockatrice beneath Sarraza, putting Samor in debt to Mishra.
events.quote: This forced Samor to bind the beast beneath the mountain of Sarraza rather than kill it.

events.summary: Porros cuts Samor's throat with a mirror shard and Samor curses him to become a sand wraith.
events.quote: Porros took a broken mirror shard and cut Samor's throat

events.summary: Porros draws a cyclone of sand that buries Sumifa while its people flee to the Nessian Caves.
events.quote: Sumifa was buried under tons of sand

events.summary: More than 3000 years later, an archaeological team rediscovers the buried city.
events.quote: rediscovered the ancient, buried remains of the city
